name: LuaJIT
needs: LuaJIT 2.0 or newer and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: LuaJIT's FFI declares functions with a C-syntax string (`ffi.cdef`). That string lives inside `peep.lua`; there is no separate header file.
This needs LuaJIT. Plain PUC Lua (5.x) has no built-in FFI.
`read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: decodes the test files and prints checksums
